failedDesc: After saving, a new connection can't reach the admin UI, so this change may have cut off the way you are connected. It is confirmed automatically once access comes back; if it still can't be confirmed in time, Gately rolls back to the previous configuration and restarts.
foundDesc: These changes were saved but access hasn't been confirmed yet. If you opened this page through the changed setup, keep them; otherwise Gately rolls back to the previous configuration and restarts when time runs out.
rollingBackDesc: Gately is restoring the previous configuration and restarting. The page reloads once it is back; keep this page open.
confirmFailed: Confirmation failed: a new connection can't reach the admin UI
rolledBackTimeout: The changes to {modules} weren't confirmed in time and were rolled back. The changed version is kept in Config History.
rolledBackManual: The changes to {modules} were rolled back as you requested. The changed version is kept in Config History.
rolledBackBoots: The changes to {modules} weren't confirmed and Gately started several times in a row, so they were rolled back. The changed version is kept in Config History.
unreachable: Gately can't be reached right now, so "Roll back now" can't get through either; wait for the automatic rollback when the countdown ends, or run this on the server:
rollbackUnreachable: Gately can't be reached, so it can't roll back now: wait for the automatic rollback when the countdown ends, or run gately rollback -pending on the server
